name: shopping-platform-microservices
description: Shopping platform with 6 microservices, all in-memory (no database)

scripts.start: concurrently --names "GATEWAY,USERS,PRODUCTS,ORDERS,CART" --prefix-colors "cyan,blue,green,yellow,magenta" "node gateway.js" "node user-service/server.js" "node product-service/server.js" "node order-service/server.js" "node cart-service/server.js"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd user-service && npm install && cd ../product-service && npm install && cd ../order-service && npm install && cd ../cart-service && npm install && cd ../review-service && npm install && cd ../notification-service && npm install
